# thetalake_swrv_rule (Resource)

The SWRV rule resource allows for the creation and management of smart workflow review rules within Theta Lake.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thetalake_swrv_rule" "example" {
  name                 = "customer-escalations"
  description          = "Review customer escalations routed into the workflow"
  policy_id            = 147
  retention_library_id = 1
  workflow_id          = 14536
  priority             = 4

  input_sources = [{
    type = "all_uploads"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) The description of the SWRV rule
- `input_sources` (Attributes List) The input sources for the SWRV rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_sources))
- `name` (String) The name of the SWRV rule
- `policy_id` (Number) The policy ID associated with this SWRV rule
- `retention_library_id` (Number) The retention library ID associated with this SWRV rule
- `workflow_id` (Number) The workflow ID associated with this SWRV rule

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) The priority of the SWRV rule. Lower numbers have higher priority.
- `supervision_space_id` (Number) The supervision space ID associated with this SWRV rule

### Read-Only

- `default_rule` (Boolean) Indicates if this is the default SWRV rule
- `id` (Number) The SWRV rule ID
- `is_built_in` (Boolean) Indicates if this is a built-in SWRV rule
- `policy_name` (String) The policy name associated with this SWRV rule
- `retention_library_name` (String) The retention library name associated with this SWRV rule
- `search_id` (Number) The saved search ID associated with this SWRV rule, if any
- `search_name` (String) The saved search name associated with this SWRV rule, if any
- `supervision_space_name` (String) The supervision space name associated with this SWRV rule, if any
- `workflow_name` (String) The workflow name associated with this SWRV rule

<a id="nestedatt--input_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `input_sources`

Required:

- `type` (String) The input source type

Optional:

- `id` (Number) The integration ID. Required when `type` is `integration`.
